fnol_text: My name is Kwame Lindqvist and I live at 557 Juniper Drive, Madison, WI 53750. You can reach me on (555) 348-9337 or kwame.lindqvist@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 11 December 2024 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2024-00060. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Lindqvist on (555) 348-9337 to acknowledge the claim. Kwame confirmed the loss date as 11 December 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Marcus Novak gave a statement by phone.
Kwame sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
